    • getUser

      Returns the User object associated with the Transaction object. The User object contains the information about the user who made the transaction.

      The User object associated with the Transaction object.

    • setUser

      public void setUser(User user)
      Sets the User object associated with the Transaction object. The User object contains the information about the user who made the transaction.
      Parameters:
      user - The User object to associate with the Transaction object.

    • getCryptoCurrency

      public CryptoCurrency getCryptoCurrency()
      Returns the CryptoCurrency object associated with the Transaction object. The CryptoCurrency object contains the information about the crypto currency in which the transaction was made.
      Returns:
      The CryptoCurrency object associated with the Transaction object.

    • setCryptoCurrency

      public void setCryptoCurrency(CryptoCurrency cryptoCurrency)
      Sets the CryptoCurrency object associated with the Transaction object. The CryptoCurrency object contains the information about the crypto currency in which the transaction was made.
      Parameters:
      cryptoCurrency - The CryptoCurrency object to associate with the Transaction object.

    • getAmountInvested

      public double getAmountInvested()
      Returns the amount invested in the transaction. The amount invested is the total value of the transaction.
      Returns:
      The amount invested in the transaction.

    • setAmountInvested

      public void setAmountInvested(double amountInvested)
      Sets the amount invested in the transaction. The amount invested is the total value of the transaction.
      Parameters:
      amountInvested - The amount invested in the transaction.

    • getPriceAtTransaction

      public double getPriceAtTransaction()
      Returns the price of the cryptocurrency at the time of the transaction. The price at transaction is the cost per unit of the cryptocurrency when the transaction was executed.
      Returns:
      The price of the cryptocurrency at the time of the transaction.

    • setPriceAtTransaction

      public void setPriceAtTransaction(double priceAtTransaction)
      Sets the price of the cryptocurrency at the time of the transaction. The price at transaction is the cost per unit of the cryptocurrency when the transaction was executed.
      Parameters:
      priceAtTransaction - The price of the cryptocurrency to set at the time of the transaction.

    • getQuantity

      public double getQuantity()
      Returns the quantity of the cryptocurrency involved in the transaction. The quantity is the amount of the cryptocurrency that was involved in the transaction, and is calculated by dividing the amount invested by the price of the cryptocurrency at the time of the transaction.
      Returns:
      The quantity of the cryptocurrency involved in the transaction.

    • setQuantity

      public void setQuantity(double quantity)
      Sets the quantity of the cryptocurrency involved in the transaction.
      Parameters:
      quantity - The quantity of the cryptocurrency to set.

    • getTransactionDate

      public LocalDateTime getTransactionDate()
      Returns the transaction date of the Transaction object. The transaction date is a LocalDateTime object that represents the date and time when the Transaction object was created.
      Returns:
      The transaction date of the Transaction object.

    • setTransactionDate

      public void setTransactionDate(LocalDateTime transactionDate)
      Sets the transaction date of the Transaction object. The transaction date is a LocalDateTime object that represents the date and time when the Transaction object was created.
      Parameters:
      transactionDate - The transaction date to set for the Transaction object.
